trailhead.label: Bivio dei Pellegrini, beside the small Pellegrini car park (Pian dei Buoi)

waypoints.label: Drinking-water point at Bivio dei Pellegrini

cautions: Unpaved military tracks open to farm and forestry vehicles.
WWI trenches, caverns and ruins beside the path; tunnel roofs are unsafe.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
